corpus/sample-location-permission.md.title: The location button with the permission denied, then allowed when asked

meta.title: The location button with the permission denied, then allowed when asked
meta.description: On the place picker, the location button asks for the phone's position. With the permission denied (a host's location stand-in), the app says it cannot get the location and leaves the form empty. Allowed when asked, the position of the Simulator's or the emulator's default place fills the form, and Done shows that place.

steps.value: "Turn on the location service to use your current place."

argv: app.wait → ["wait","\"Turn on the location service to use your current place.\""]

corpus/settings.md.title: A preference that persists, and a link the app opens, in a Flutter app

meta.title: A preference that persists, and a link the app opens, in a Flutter app
meta.description: Turns a setting on, leaves the screen and comes back to find it read again from shared_preferences, and checks the help link with url_launcher. On a host the link is also opened, where the host writes it down instead of leaving the app; a device would leave the app for the browser, so it does not open it there.
